title: Fi-Né electrifies with passion in new single "Just Touch Me"
htmlContent: Fi-Né, the pair of Taiwanese Suzy and a Panamanian with Guyanese Phil, re-conceive what cross-genre fusion can feel like on their latest single, "Just Touch Me." "Just Touch Me" glides smoothly across worlds of hip-hop, jazz, R&B, electronic, and pop, but it's all of one mind. Equally expressive and agile, Suzy's harmonious voice glides effortlessly over Phil's complex rhythms and sharp rap designs. Fi-Né is crafting a vibe all their own. "Just Touch Me" is about emotional electricity, the spark that occurs when rhythm, voice, and feeling collide. https://open.spotify.com/track/6rJvmehcujb6eg3oPffscQ Since forming in 2016, Fi-Né has been building something quietly special, a sound that's global, experimental, and deeply human. This single captures that perfectly, and it's thoughtful. "Just Touch Me" is evidence that music doesn't have to fit one box to touch people. With each note, Fi-Né welcomes you into the mysterious world where cultures come together, sounds blend, and emotion is at its core. Follow Fi-Né on Instagram
